lines.text: Many learners say: Please open your shoes.
Better: Please take off your shoes.
Take off! Please take off your shoes here.

native.tip: Kita bilang “buka sepatu”, tapi bahasa Inggris pakai take off: take off your shoes.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Please open your shoes.” 😅 Untuk sepatu dan baju, pakai take off: “Please take off your shoes.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “take off”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Please take off your shoes.” Lalu ganti shoes dengan jacket. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “buka sepatu”, but English uses take off: take off your shoes.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Please open your shoes.” 😅 For shoes and clothes, use take off: “Please take off your shoes.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
